transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm coming in today because I've been struggling a lot with eating unusually large amounts of food in one sitting. It really scares me because once I start, I feel like I completely lose control and just can't stop.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to try to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, misusing laxatives, or excessive exercising?
No, I don't do any of those things. I have never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or exercise excessively after an episode.

latest_inference.note: The patient explicitly denied compensatory behaviors such as self-induced vomiting, misuse of laxatives, or excessive exercise. These behaviors are required for a diagnosis of Bulimia Nervosa. As the patient meets the criteria for recurrent binge eating episodes without compensatory behaviors, Binge-Eating Disorder remains the only viable candidate.
